description: Keeps the digest-pinned base images (Dockerfile), the digest-pinned builder images of the release workflow (binfmt, BuildKit, the SBOM scanner) and the SHA-pinned actions current. Go modules and npm packages are updated by hand and gated in CI by govulncheck and npm audit.

customManagers.description: Builder images in the workflows' action inputs (image: and driver-opts image= of the setup actions, sbom generator= of build-push-action), which the github-actions manager does not read. deploy/workflows_test.go checks that this matches every pin.

packageRules.description: Go and Node: stay on the lines the project targets; only patches and digests.
Wait 3 days before pinning a new action release.
Builder images: wait 3 days like the actions (a moved tag is the attack the pins stop), in one group.
binfmt: follow its qemu-vX.Y.Z tags, not the desktop-, buildkit- or -NN build tags (Renovate's docker versioning cannot read the qemu- prefix).
